description: This file defines the interface for the HdmiInput class, which manages HDMI input functionalities including port management, video scaling, EDID information, and status queries in a device-related context.

classes.name: HdmiInput
classes.description: This class manages HDMI Input, providing methods to query and control HDMI input ports, video modes, EDID info, and other related functions.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the HdmiInput class.

methods.name: getNumberOfInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of HDMI input ports available.

methods.name: isPresented
methods.description: Checks if the HDMI input is currently presented.

methods.name: isActivePort
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is active.

methods.name: getActivePort
methods.description: Returns the currently active HDMI port.

methods.name: isPortConnected
methods.description: Checks if a specific HDMI port is connected.

methods.name: selectPort
methods.description: Selects a specific HDMI port, optionally requesting audio mixing and setting video plane type.

methods.name: scaleVideo
methods.description: Adjusts the video scaling parameters.

methods.name: selectZoomMode
methods.description: Selects the zoom mode for video display.

methods.name: pauseAudio
methods.description: Pauses audio on the HDMI input.

methods.name: resumeAudio
methods.description: Resumes audio on the HDMI input.

methods.name: getCurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current video mode as a string.

methods.name: getCurrentVideoModeObj
methods.description: Populates a dsVideoPortResolution_t structure with current video resolution information.

methods.name: getEDIDBytesInfo
methods.description: Retrieves EDID bytes for a specified HDMI port.

methods.name: getHDMISPDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves HDM SPD info bytes for a specified port.

methods.name: setEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the EDID version for a specific port.

methods.name: getEdidVersion
methods.description: Gets the EDID version for a specific port.

methods.name: getHdmiALLMStatus
methods.description: Checks the ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) status for a port.

methods.name: getSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves a list of supported game features.

methods.name: getAVLatency
methods.description: Retrieves audio and video latency information.

methods.name: setEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Configures EDID support for ALLM.

methods.name: getEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Checks if the EDID supports ALLM for a port.
